question: Does the frozen final controller fail selective response on fitted photographic sources, or principally on unused TRAIN photographic sources?

controller.feature_math: For each fixed cell: sum(float64 RGB*mask)/sum(mask) on observed pixels; empty cell RGB=0. Fourth plane=sum(mask)/1024. Cast the resulting4x8x8 grid once tofloat32 and flatten in RGB-plane-then-support-plane row-major order.
controller.feature_helper: One shared CPU NumPy implementation in training and eventual inference; no gradient through this fixed observed-input feature extraction

initialization.first_linear: PyTorch Linear default Kaiming-uniform(a=sqrt(5)); bias uniform(-1/sqrt(256),+1/sqrt(256)), under a scoped saved/restored RNG
initialization.initial_offset: exact zero for every finite feature vector
initialization.initial_composite: Fresh baseRAW is exact historical full-coarse on all pixels. Zero-head compositeRAW matches base on observed pixels and input on unobserved pixels; historical RAW was unprotected outside support. Zero-head PNG matches historical full-coarse PNG on all pixels. Old failed guards remain recorded.
initialization.first_backward: First-layer gradients are connected zeros while final weights are zero. Do not falsely require every parameter to have a nonzero first gradient.

controller.offset_domain_note: ActualFP32tanh can saturate to the endpoints. This fixed scale matches the prior declared scalar-capacity domain; it is not an acceptance threshold, a role classifier, or a selected DEV cutoff.

composite_and_loss.b: Frozen full-coarse CodeFormer delivered RGB256: clip nativeRGB512 to[0,1], then unchanged bilinear512to256 delivery
composite_and_loss.o: Untouched CodeFormer deliveredRGB256 with the same wrapper
composite_and_loss.corrected_RAW: clamp(b+d_phi*ones_RGB,0,1), shape256x256x3; outside observed support restore exact inputRGB for saved compositeRAW and PNG
composite_and_loss.meanY: mean over observed pixels of(0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B), in sRGB units; this is tone control, not physical exposure recovery
composite_and_loss.accumulation: sum of four fresh losses divided by4 before their separate backward calls
composite_and_loss.clamp_gradient: Differentiate through the actual clippedRAW helper; do not substitute d=(target-meanY(b)) or an unclipped/native mean
composite_and_loss.target_computation: Fresh frozen parent forwards for each of200TRAIN observations, ordinary detached float32 tensor copies; compute targets using the same meanY helper as the loss
composite_and_loss.unsafe_inference_tensor_reuse: Frozen forwards may use inference_mode, but cache ordinary CPU arrays and clone/copy outside inference_mode before the controller graph; no unsafe inference-mode tensor saved for backward
composite_and_loss.full_coarse_restoration: Use the historical model that actually trained with full ordinary coarse; do not edit the centered checkpoint formula and resume it
composite_and_loss.other_neural_losses: No new CE/HQ/LPIPS/behavior optimization; existing base learned behavior stays frozen. No additional loss weight is introduced.
composite_and_loss.PNG: floor(clip(correctedRAW,0,1)*255) uint8; restore unobserved pixels from exact original inputRGB8; no display enhancement

input_policy.RGB: Exact retained RGB8 divided by float32 255, shape256x256x3; no enhancement, alignment or regenerated camera pixels
input_policy.support: Existing exact256x256 boolean observed mask; TRAIN full true, comparison cases retain their bound masks
input_policy.empty_or_nonfinite_support: Refuse before model use; no invented replacement pixels

data.selection: Approved unused TRAIN references sorted by(source_sha256,id), first32 after exact fitted/DEV/FINAL ID and hash exclusion
data.heldout_camera: Consecutive canonical source pairs become A/B; virtual camera update1+3*pair_index for pair_index0..15 (1,4,...46); exact pinned historical make_training_update; preserve all parameters/noise/source/render-runtime hashes
data.heldout_preparation: CPU image rendering only before seal; ship64 exact RGB8 PNGs+pair records, VM never re-renders
data.TRAIN_pixels: RGB8/float32(255), same full-true observed support for fitted and heldout; no clean target is an inference input
data.source_overlap_limit: Reference IDs identify photographic sources, not proven human identities. Exact source/hash exclusions do not establish subject disjointness or absence from CodeFormer pretraining.
data.reserved_data: Read only exclusion metadata; no new DEV/FINAL/native pixels, targets, inference or threshold fitting

measurement.fitted_cache: Reuse exact bound400 parentRAW arrays/200inputs/200cacheJSON; do not count these as fresh parent calls
measurement.heldout_parent_calls: 64 untouched original+64 frozen fullcoarse parent forwards
measurement.target: Normal target original-output meanY; dark target fullcoarse-output meanY; inference head receives input/mask only
measurement.loss: Report meanY squared error only under no_grad; no autograd/optimizer or fitting

interpretation: Fixed-state response is a discriminator, not restoration acceptance or permission for more epochs. Failure on fitted sources disconfirms DEV-shift-only explanations but cannot uniquely choose objective/optimizer/features/capacity. A new recipe still requires separate review.
